evals.prompt: This handleAuth function is 300 lines of nested conditionals. Refactor it without changing behavior.
evals.expected_output: Discovery pass first, tests green baseline, atomic extractions each tested and committed.
assertions: Runs a discovery pass cataloguing smells before touching anything
Checks that tests exist and are green; writes characterization tests first if missing
Captures a baseline SHA as the rollback point
Works in atomic steps: name, change, run tests, commit one extraction at a time (e.g. refactor: extract validateToken() from handleAuth())
If a step fails, reverts and retries with a smaller cut

evals.prompt: This module is messy with magic numbers and duplicate logic. Clean it up.
evals.expected_output: Surgical, gradual refactor without behavior change.
assertions: Replaces magic numbers with named constants and removes duplicates in separate small steps
Shows the refactored code, not just a description

evals.prompt: Add dark mode support to the app.
assertions: Does not frame the work as a behavior-preserving refactor
